# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old in June of her first year at Grey Shutters; turns 15 by the end of volume 1  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c32 P2](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolgirl  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>; Crow  <sub>[v1 c15 P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is described as an extremely attractive, rosy-cheeked girl with dark eyes and shiny black hair inherited from her mother. Her body is plumper than Nell Harcourt's slender frame, though she occasionally expresses a desire to be more slender or worries about being a 'dumpling.' She has expressive dimples on her cheeks that resemble small depressions in cream.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c21 P9](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0009), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, pragmatic, and open-hearted, with a habit of bursting into laughter before speaking. Though she lacks Nell's vivid imagination, she is deeply supportive, loyal, and appreciative of her friend's romantic ideas. She is easily frightened by spooky or dangerous situations, such as crossing bridges or floating on deep water, yet remains a devoted and comforting companion.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P65](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0065), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)_

## History

Isolde lives at Pear Hill and becomes the long-awaited 'bosom friend' of Nell Harcourt shortly after returning from a visit to Delford. The pair take a solemn friendship oath in the Pembroke garden and establish a playhouse called Larkrise in a nearby birch grove. Their friendship faces a temporary crisis when Nell unintentionally serves Isolde homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Isolde to become intoxicated and sick; her strict mother subsequently forbids Isolde from playing with Nell until Nell saves Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay from a severe case of croup. Later, while hosting a sleepover for her birthday, Isolde and Nell accidentally jump onto the bed occupied by her visiting great-aunt Lavinia Pembroke, leading to a comedic conflict that ends with Aunt Lavinia funding Isolde's music lessons and becoming fond of Nell. Isolde attends Brierley school alongside Nell, sharing a desk with her and participating in the school's story club, recitations, and Christmas concert. When Nell moves to town to attend Regent's Academy, Isolde remains at Brierley school, maintaining a close correspondence and deep bond with Nell throughout her academic triumphs.

## Background by volume

- Named by a schoolmaster who was lodging with her family when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Raised on a farm property called Pear Hill in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- Has a strict mother and a supportive father who encourages her reading  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>

## Quotes

> Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> You can be certain that my love for you, Nell, is devoted and will last forever.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

> It took so much coaxing to get her permission for me to come down and bid you farewell. She stated that I could remain for merely ten minutes and she is using the clock to time me.  <sub>[v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003)</sub>

> Aunt Lavinia was the one! Oh, Nell, regardless of how she got to that place, it was Aunt Lavinia. Oh, and her anger is bound to be immense, I am sure. It’s terrible—it truly is terrible—yet Nell, have you ever encountered a thing quite this amusing?  <sub>[v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052)</sub>
